clips.title: The story
paras: Stationed along the contested road leading east from Ashenvale into Azshara, the Warsong Outrider keeps watch over the Horde's frontier. She serves as an advanced scout for the Warsong clan, monitoring travelers and relaying crucial intelligence back to their forward encampments. Although armed and vigilant against night elf incursions, she maintains a passive watch unless directly provoked.

The borderlands between Ashenvale and the shattered ruins of Azshara are fraught with danger. Operating far from the fortified safety of Splintertree Post or the lumber camps, the Warsong Outrider observes troop movements and patrols the transit corridor. Armed with a bow and toxic stingers, she stands ready to defend the Horde's claim over the region, though she conserves her strength by only firing upon Alliance trespassers who actively attack her.
